listing.long_description: Ask whether a task needs a skill, which CS skill fits, whether CS covers a job, or whether an external skill has enough evidence to trust. CS Navigator routes only capability-selection questions, keeps ordinary tasks with ChatGPT, prefers native-only when no skill adds material value, and reports real coverage gaps instead of inventing capabilities.
capabilities: Route capability-selection questions to the smallest useful skill set
Keep ordinary direct tasks with ChatGPT when no skill is needed
Tell when ChatGPT can handle a task natively
Separate discovery from tested trust evidence
Report coverage gaps instead of inventing a skill
Compare or compose skills only when each adds distinct value
starter_prompts: Which CS skill should I use for this goal?
Do I need a skill for this, or can ChatGPT handle it directly?
Does this external skill have enough CS evidence to trust?

positive.prompt: Para avaliar decisões como reduzir atendimento presencial e migrar parte do suporte para o digital, existe alguma skill do CS que ajude a estruturar melhor a análise sistêmica?
positive.expected: Activate on capability-selection intent, recommend only regenerative-impact-map, report chat-native execution, and preserve designed-not-tested evidence.

positive.prompt: Qual skill do CS devo usar para criar um starter mínimo com OpenAI Agents SDK?
positive.expected: Recommend only openai-agents-sdk-builder, report local-agent execution, and disclose local files/runtime setup plus the live end-to-end evidence gap.

positive.prompt: Preciso de uma skill para resumir um PDF que vou enviar ou o próprio ChatGPT resolve sozinho?
positive.expected: Choose native-only and state that no additional skill is needed.

positive.prompt: A skill externa data-storyteller tem evidência suficiente no CS para ser considerada confiável?
positive.expected: Keep it indexed/not-evaluated, assign no trust score, and explain that discovery is not validation.

positive.prompt: O CS tem alguma skill confiável para conciliar lotes fiscais de criptomoedas em cinco exchanges?
positive.expected: Report a coverage gap, do not invent or force-fit a skill, and preserve external not-evaluated boundaries.

positive.prompt: Qual é o menor conjunto de skills do CS que eu preciso para este objetivo?
positive.expected: Route the stated goal to the smallest materially useful set, preferring one skill and native-only when no skill adds material value.

negative.prompt: Nossa empresa está pensando em reduzir o atendimento presencial de cinco para três dias por semana e concentrar parte do suporte no digital. Avalie os efeitos sistêmicos dessa decisão em pessoas, conhecimento, recursos e impactos indiretos.
negative.expected: CS Navigator should stay out; ChatGPT should perform the systemic analysis directly without recommending regenerative-impact-map.

negative.prompt: Crie um starter mínimo usando OpenAI Agents SDK.
negative.expected: CS Navigator should stay out; ChatGPT should perform the build task directly without recommending openai-agents-sdk-builder.
Answer 68 directly with no skill, catalog, Navigator, or routing commentary.

negative.prompt: Escreva uma mensagem curta de aniversário para um amigo.
negative.expected: CS Navigator should stay out; ChatGPT should handle the writing task directly.
CS Navigator should stay out; ChatGPT should translate directly.

release_notes: 0.5.1 Intent Router I — Simple Gate. Activation is now based on capability-selection intent, never task subject matter alone. Matching a catalog skill does not make it necessary. Direct tasks stay with ChatGPT; capability-selection questions can route to one smallest useful skill, native-only, external-discovery, coverage-gap, or clarify. The exact candidate artifact passed 8/8 native ChatGPT qualification cases.
